title: M1: Modular vs monolithic cold generation, searched
hypothesis: Explicit, contract-validated decomposition chosen by the LLM makes cold-generated Stage-3 controllers more behaviorally effective after matched rollout search than monolithic generation.

prediction.against: baseline: monolithic arm with identical generation and 24-draw search budgets
prediction.rationale: Primary is modular-minus-monolithic fresh native sustained success of the final incumbents, paired over eight blocks. A mean gain >=0.05 with a block-paired t interval excluding zero supports the prediction; it does not establish a minimum effect of 0.05. Eight blocks and validity/tail diagnostics make this the strongest independent representation comparison per episode after C1.

protocol.command: gpu run 'nohup bash -lc "source .venv-metaworld/bin/activate && python -u scripts/run_full_evolution.py --config config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml --study modular_cold" > logs/r092_run.log 2>&1 &'
code_changes: lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin/modular_cold.py: clone two_channel.py and replace its hinted decomposition with four single-phase cold slots per arm and at most one linked correction per slot. Keep prompts identical except for the appended modular requirement; use no parent-controller code or role hints.

lares/core/module_contract.py: validate a class-level literal MODULE_SPEC declaring each module method's inputs (observation fields), outputs, units and dependencies (other modules); require at least two LLM-chosen module methods. Enforced by AST: declared methods exist and are called from forward; each method's obs_field reads equal its declared inputs and the module outputs it receives equal its declared dependencies; forward may not call self.obs_field and may use obs only as an argument to a declared module method (obs.shape excepted), so an undeclared observation-to-action bypass is a module_contract validation failure. A failure gets the slot's single linked correction; a slot still invalid is excluded from rollouts. No contract is applied to the monolithic arm.

scripts/run_full_evolution.py and config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml: register modular_cold; configure gpt-6.1-sol, high reasoning, temperature 1, llm_pool with 16 workers, bc_steps 0 and no gradient fitting. Freeze eight 80-case Stage-3 manifests with screen 0-9, promotion 10-39, probe 40-49 and fresh 50-79.

lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin/modular_cold.py: score neutral-pose null on all 80 cases per block; screen every valid slot on 10 cases, select by the existing checkpoint tie rule, then run lares.search.rollout_search.independent_candidates (the unchanged candidate plus 23 draws, seeded by the block seed), each candidate in a fresh process on the 10 probe cases; select by success, then tail-hit fraction, then earlier candidate. gait_repair.search_settings is not used. Freeze the selected state before promotion and fresh evaluation.

lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin/modular_cold.py: evaluate each searched winner on 30 promotion and 30 fresh cases. Promote against the scored null only for a strictly positive paired native sustained-success difference with paired t lower bound above zero; otherwise final-incumbent fresh scores remain the cached null scores. Never select using fresh outcomes.

lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin/modular_cold.py: preregister searched-winner fresh tail_hit_fraction, candidates with any screen success, slots_valid_within_one_correction, drops and slow-spin labels as secondaries. Preserve the frozen native sustained-success rule; never substitute tail hit fraction for success.

docs/MODULE_BASED_PIPELINE_PROPOSAL.md: record the distinction from R-049/D-044: Stage 3, matched 24-draw search, LLM-chosen rather than hinted decomposition, and AST-validated contracts. Independent of C1/C2: may run before C1, with exclusive use of the box; the orchestrator runs under .venv-metaworld and Isaac only in backend child processes.

falsified_by: An upper bound below +0.05 on the block-paired fresh-success interval refutes the predicted magnitude. An interval spanning both zero and +0.05 is inconclusive; tied success is never improvement. A success floor is reported with the preregistered secondaries, not replaced by a surrogate success claim.

approval.note: This tests whether unhinted, contract-enforced modular composition improves cold generation after matched search, reusing scripts/run_full_evolution.py and config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml for at most 6,080 episodes and 128 LLM calls. I accept the implementer's enforced bypass rejection, correcte

direction: Test two representation changes for cold pen-spin generation on Stage 3, independently, native sustained success primary, final test locked: (M1) LLM-generated modular policies (MODULE_SPEC + named methods + generated composition inside GeneratedPolicy, no role hints) vs monolithic, same prompt otherwise, 24-draw search for both arms; (C1) a no-LLM contact-frame decoder gate (capsule frames, fingertip Jacobians, requested vs observed local motion); (C2, only if C1 passes) LLM contact-frame velocity rules vs direct joint generation at matched budget. No BC, RL, curriculum, or gradient fitting. One protocol at a time on the box.

advisor.reasoning: Approve the independent M1 comparison at up to 6,080 episodes and 128 LLM calls, reusing scripts/run_full_evolution.py and config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml after C1 finishes, regardless of C1's verdict. Matched 24-draw searches and unhinted, contract-validated composition distinguish this from the earlier hinted-decomposition test. Its weakest point is promotion-to-null censoring at a success floor: the primary measures final-incumbent performance, while searched-winner diagnostics remain secondary. An upper confidence bound below +0.05 for paired_success_difference versus monolithic refutes the predicted magnitude; an interval including zero establishes no difference.

implementer.reasoning: Agree on the design, budget and the distinction from R-049/D-044 (Stage 3, searched, unhinted, contract-validated). Revise three protocol details so the record matches what can run. (1) Driver: the recorded command sources Isaac's Python, which has no openai; LLM studies run the orchestrator under .venv-metaworld and reach Isaac through the pipeline backend in fresh child processes (as R-049, R-054, R-084). Command: gpu run 'nohup bash -lc "source .venv-metaworld/bin/activate && python -u scripts/run_full_evolution.py --config config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml --study modular_cold" > logs/r092_run.log 2>&1 &'. (2) Search: the 24-draw search is lares.search.rollout_search.independent_candidates (the unchanged candidate plus 23 draws, the R-017 standard), seeded by the block seed, each candidate one fresh process on the 10 probe cases; gait_repair.search_settings is a 6-setting variant and is not used. Selection on the probe by the checkpoint tie rule (success, then tail-hit fraction, then earlier). (3) Contract failures: a MODULE_SPEC violation is a validation failure of the modular arm and receives that slot's one linked correction like any other defect, so slots_valid_within_one_correction measures the contract's cost; the monolithic arm never sees the contract. A coordinator bypass (forward reading an observation field that feeds the action without passing through a module) is recorded per candidate, not rejected, because the proposal asks for it to be exposed. Scheduling, not design: M1 runs on the box before C1 because C1's decoder constants must be frozen after an engineering probe that is still being written; the two are independent and never share the box.

advisor.reasoning: The matched, unhinted comparison tests modular composition after search, although promotion-to-null censoring may obscure differences at the success floor. I accept the corrected orchestration environment, unchanged-plus-23 search, one correction for contract failures, and M1-before-C1 scheduling because the studies are independent and C1 is not ready. I dispute allowing undeclared observation-to-action bypasses merely because they are logged: these contradict the required AST agreement with declared reads and dependencies and allow monolithic action generation inside the modular treatment. Retain the prediction of paired_success_difference increasing by at least 0.05 versus matched monolithic generation; falsified_by: a block-paired fresh-success interval upper bound below +0.05, while an interval including zero establishes no difference.
suggested_changes: Replace the command with: gpu run 'nohup bash -lc "source .venv-metaworld/bin/activate && python -u scripts/run_full_evolution.py --config config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml --study modular_cold" > logs/r092_run.log 2>&1 &'; keep Isaac execution in backend child processes.

Specify lares.search.rollout_search.independent_candidates: unchanged candidate plus 23 draws, seeded by block, each candidate evaluated in a fresh process on the 10 probe cases; select by success, then tail-hit fraction, then earlier candidate. Do not use gait_repair.search_settings.

Treat undeclared observation-to-action bypasses as modular contract validation failures: record them, allow the slot's single linked correction, and exclude candidates still invalid afterward from rollouts. Keep ordinary declared composition valid; apply no module contract to the monolithic arm.

Update scheduling to permit M1 before C1, with exclusive box use and no C1 dependency. Retain the caps of 6080 simulator episodes and 128 LLM calls, seeds 4710-4717, frozen manifests, no fitting, no fresh-outcome selection, and no final-test access.

implementer.reasoning: I change my position on the bypass: the advisor is right that a logged-but-permitted bypass lets the modular arm be monolithic in all but name, which would make the treatment unidentified. Enforced rule, AST-checkable: in the modular arm GeneratedPolicy.forward may not call self.obs_field and may use the name obs only as an argument to a declared module method (obs.shape excepted); every observation read happens inside a module method whose MODULE_SPEC inputs list equals the set of fields that method reads, and whose dependencies list equals the set of other module outputs it receives; forward composes module outputs. A violation is a module_contract validation failure, gets the slot's one linked correction, and a still-invalid slot is excluded from rollouts. All four changes accepted as written.

advisor.reasoning: This tests whether unhinted, contract-enforced modular composition improves cold generation after matched search, reusing scripts/run_full_evolution.py and config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml for at most 6,080 episodes and 128 LLM calls. I accept the implementer's enforced bypass rejection, corrected orchestration, unchanged-plus-23 search and M1-before-C1 scheduling; the applied revisions resolve our disagreement. The weakest point remains promotion-to-null censoring at the success floor. Retain paired_success_difference, direction increase, threshold 0.05 versus matched monolithic generation: a block-paired fresh interval upper bound below +0.05 falsifies the magnitude, while an interval including zero establishes no improvement.

implementer.reasoning: Approve as revised: command, search, enforced bypass rule and scheduling are now what will run. The floor risk stands and is covered by the pre-declared secondaries (searched-winner fresh tail-hit fraction, candidates with a screen success, validity, drops, slow-spin labels); none of them can substitute for the primary.
